signatureEvidence.explanation: Suspicious web traffic was detected on an HTTP/HTTPS port. The flow used TCP, targeted a web service port, had relatively large packet sizes, and completed within a short time window. This pattern may indicate automated or abnormal web attack behaviour.
matchedConditions: Protocol is TCP
Destination port is 80 or 443
Mean packet length is at least 300 bytes
Forward packet mean length is at least 250 bytes
Flow duration is at most 5,000,000 microseconds

technicalDetail.rationale: Web attack traffic commonly uses HTTP or HTTPS destination ports. Larger packet length means can indicate request-heavy or payload-heavy web flows. This flow-level heuristic cannot inspect URLs, request parameters, SQL strings, or XSS payloads.
